findings.mechanism: Read‑modify‑write without SELECT FOR UPDATE or atomic UPDATE causes lost updates under READ COMMITTED (01‑isolation‑levels).
findings.remediation: Wrap the SELECT in SELECT FOR UPDATE or replace the read‑modify‑write with a single UPDATE … SET balance = balance - :amount, or run at SERIALIZABLE with retry logic.
findings.arithmetic: Initial balance=100, N=10 concurrent debits of 10 each. Each transaction reads 100, passes check, writes 90. Only one write wins, so final_balance=90 → final_balance ≥90 under the scenario.

prediction.condition: 10 concurrent debits of 10.00 on initial balance 100.00
